name: checkout_paths
goal: Log in to SauceDemo with the supplied credentials. Follow the selected routes exactly. If product_route is 'inventory', add {{product_name}} to the cart directly from the Products page. If product_route is 'details', first open the {{product_name}} product details page and add it to the cart from there. Then, if cart_route is 'cart_link', open the cart by clicking the visible shopping cart control at the top right; if cart_route is 'cart_url', navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html. Click Checkout, fill in the first name, last name and postal code, click Continue to reach the Checkout: Overview page, extract only the displayed Total as the output named total, and stop there. Never click Finish.
